concerns: Reading 24: 攻 → ぜ. The standard reading for 攻 (seme) is せ. While rendaku can occur, ぜ is not a common or standard reading for 攻 in this context (攻め).
Reading 16: 囲 → がこ. The standard reading for 囲 (kakoi) is かこ. While rendaku can occur, がこ is not a standard reading for 囲 in this context (囲い). The previous entry for 囲 (14) correctly uses かこ.
